title: Region-aware purge proof assembler and user-initiated RTBF evidence portal
creator: Priya Malhotra
description: Build a cross-environment system that produces verifiable, region-stamped proof bundles after automated deletion runs. This ticket covers the product requirements, the user-facing evidence portal for tenant admins and end users, and the orchestration contract for runtime/ingest teams so that Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments can emit signed deletion attestations. The goal is a single RTBF flow that: (1) executes per-tenant deletions according to retention and residency rules, (2) collects cryptographic receipts from each storage/control-plane shard, (3) composes a tamper-evident proof bundle (manifest + per-region attestations + Merkle root), and (4) serves the bundle to requesting parties via the Console and via a programmatic evidence API. This must work for multi-region tenants where data residency constraints require partial-shard purges and for air-gapped Private deployments where evidence is exported as an attestable archive.
acceptance_criteria: RTBF API endpoint returns an evidence package URL within SLO (initial target: 30 minutes for medium-sized tenants)
Evidence bundle contains: deletion manifest, per-shard signed receipts, Merkle root, sequence timestamps, and region stamps
Console UI shows a downloadable, human-readable certificate plus the raw signed bundle
Automated verifier job can replay receipts and flag mismatches (false-negative rate < 0.1%)
Support for Dedicated and Private: local agent emits receipts to control plane; on air-gapped installs the bundle can be exported to customer-controlled storage
End-to-end e2e test that simulates a 3-region tenant and validates that all region-specific retention rules were honored
implementation_plan: Product: finalize manifest schema and UX copy for evidence portal
Design: mock Console evidence page and downloadable certificate layout
ENG-runtime: add receipt emission hooks to purge worker; receipts must be signed with KMS-managed keys
ENG-control-plane: implement proof assembler service that aggregates receipts and writes an immutable audit entry with Merkle root
ENG-api: expose RTBF start/status/evidence endpoints and a signed download URL
Security: review KMS key usage, signing format, and threat model for replay/tamper
QE: build deterministic scenarios for e2e verification, including RNG seeding for KV tombstone order
rollout_plan: Phase 0: API + internal proof assembler behind feature flag; test with synthetic tenants
Phase 1: Enable for low-traffic customers; run daily verifier and collect telemetry
Phase 2: Gradual GA for Hosted customers and Dedicated; provide export path for Private installs
Phase 3: Expose self-serve evidence portal in Console and document SLA/limitations
monitoring_and_alerting: Dashboard: per-tenant RTBF pipeline success/failure and per-region compliance summary
test_plan: Unit tests for manifest composer and Merkle root calculations
Integration tests: purge worker -> receipt emission -> assembler aggregation
E2E: simulated 3-region tenant with mixed retention windows; validate human-readable certificate
Performance: synthetic test that generates evidence bundle for 10k-user tenant within target latency
Security: signing verification, key-rotation tests, and tamper-detection fuzzing
open_questions: What is the canonical JSON schema for the signed receipt (fields and ordering)?
Do we need to anchor Merkle roots in an external immutable store (e.g., append-only ledger) for extra assurance?
Acceptable SLO for large tenants (100k+ PII objects)?
How should we present partial-region deletes to customers when residency prevents cross-region consolidation?
Backup/restore implications: how to guarantee evidence persists across cluster migrations
